name: Emrich-Schönleber Monzinger Frühlingsplätzchen Riesling Spätlese 2015
text:
## Emrich-Schönleber Frühlingsplätzchen Riesling Spätlese 2015

**Story.** The estate is in [Monzingen](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Monzingen,+Germany&t=k) on the Upper [Nahe](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Nahe+Valley,+Monzingen,+Germany&t=k). It farms about 20 hectares, 85% of it Riesling. Its best sites are the [Frühlingsplätzchen](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Fruhlingsplatzchen,+Monzingen,+Germany&t=k) and the [Halenberg](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Halenberg,+Monzingen,+Germany&t=k). The two families go back to the mid-18th century in the Nahe.

**Reviews.** I found no reviews for the 2015 Spätlese, from critics or from CellarTracker. Your list shows a CellarTracker community score of 96 for this wine, but I could not open the page to check it. The nearest data are other wines: the 2013 Spätlese averages 89.6 on CellarTracker (7 notes), and the 2015 dry GG averages 93.4 (22 notes). None of these tell us about your bottle.

**Practical note.** This is my judgement, not reviewer-backed. A Nahe Spätlese at nine to eleven years is usually in a good place and should hold longer. Chill it and skip the decanter. Try it with spiced duck or pork with apples.

**Curious aside: slate and volcanoes.** The Nahe's soils are very varied because of its volcanic origins. A retailer profile describes the Frühlingsplätzchen as red slate with Rotliegend loam. That is a secondary source, so treat it as indicative.

### From the history books
- 778: [Monzingen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahe_(wine_region)) is mentioned as a wine village, according to the Nahe article.
- 1971: German wine law first defines the Nahe as its own region (same article). Earlier its wines sold as plain "Rhine wine".
- 1994: the estate joins the VDP, per a producer profile. See [VDP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=Verband+Deutscher+Pr%C3%A4dikatsweing%C3%BCter&go=Go).

**Sources:** Jeb Dunnuck (subscriber site, checked directly), Uncorked, Falstaff, Farr Vintners, J.J. Buckley, Vinfolio, FRW, First Bottle, Kysela, Benchmark Wine, K&L, Whwc, Thatchers, Winewithseth, CellarTracker, Delectable, closdesspiritueux.com, and Wikipedia ([Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape_AOC), [Nahe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahe_(wine_region)), [Vouvray AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouvray_AOC), [La Clape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massif_de_la_Clape), [Avignon Papacy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avignon_Papacy), [Great French Wine Blight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_French_Wine_Blight)).
